meta_description: Get verified facts on 2025 Toyota Camry, including trim pricing, engine specs, fuel economy, and key features. Check all the essential details and updates.

faqs.question: What is the starting price of the 2025 Toyota Camry?
faqs.answer: The base LE model starts at an MSRP of approximately $28,400, excluding destination fees, taxes, and optional equipment packages.

faqs.question: Does the 2025 Toyota Camry offer all-wheel drive?
faqs.answer: Yes, electronic all-wheel drive is available as an option on every trim level by adding a rear electric motor to the hybrid powertrain.

faqs.question: What is the fuel economy for the 2025 Camry?
faqs.answer: Front-wheel drive models achieve up to an EPA-estimated 53 mpg in the city and 50 mpg on the highway for the base LE trim.

faqs.question: Are there any non-hybrid gas engines available?
faqs.answer: No, Toyota eliminated traditional gas-only engines for this generation, making every single 2025 Camry a standard hybrid vehicle.

faqs.question: What horsepower does the hybrid system produce?
faqs.answer: Front-wheel-drive variants produce 225 net horsepower, while all-wheel-drive configurations generate 232 net horsepower.

faqs.question: What size infotainment screens are available?
faqs.answer: Lower trims feature an 8.0-inch touchscreen display, while upper XLE and XSE trims upgrade to a larger 12.3-inch touchscreen.

content_html:
Introduction to the Redesigned 2025 Toyota Camry

The automotive market shifted dramatically when Toyota decided to make the redesigned sedan entirely hybrid. Buyers looking at the 2025 Toyota Camry now get standard electric-motor assistance across every single trim level.

This strategic move drops traditional gas-only engines entirely from the lineup. As a seasoned automotive editor, I spent time behind the wheel to see if this gamble pays off for everyday drivers.

Quick Specifications and Overview

The 2025 Toyota Camry is a completely redesigned midsize hybrid sedan starting at approximately $28,400. It features a fifth-generation Toyota Hybrid System, standard front-wheel drive or available electronic all-wheel drive, and delivers up to an EPA-estimated 53 mpg combined.

Shoppers often cross-shop this sedan against larger utility vehicles like the 2025 Toyota RAV4 or the rugged toyota sequoia 2025. Yet, commuters seeking high fuel economy still find traditional sedans hard to beat.

If you prefer a smaller footprint, the 2025 toyota corolla and the popular corolla cross hybrid offer alternative sizing. However, the Camry provides significantly more rear legroom and highway stability.

Pricing and Trim Level Breakdown

Understanding the toyota camry price structure helps buyers select the right trim without overpaying for unwanted features. The entry-level LE starts things off, while sporty variants attract performance-minded drivers.

While past generations offered a aggressive toyota camry trd variant, the current lineup focuses heavily on the athletic XSE trim. Buyers wanting body kits and larger wheels gravitate directly toward this sporty configuration.

Performance and Fuel Economy Numbers

Under the hood, every model pairs a 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine with electric motors. Front-wheel-drive versions put out 225 net horsepower, which moves the car with surprising eagerness.

Opting for electronic all-wheel drive bumps total output to 232 horsepower by adding a dedicated rear electric motor. This system kicks in instantly when front slippage is detected on wet roads.

Fuel efficiency remains the standout metric for this generation. Real-world testing matches the impressive EPA ratings quite closely during mixed commuting conditions.

Interior Quality and Technology Upgrades

Cabin materials represent a major step up compared to the outgoing 2022 toyota camry. Base models utilize durable cloth fabrics, while upper trims feature soft-touch surfaces and leather upholstery.

A standard 8.0-inch touchscreen handles infotainment duties on lower trims. Higher configurations upgrade to a crisp 12.3-inch display alongside a matching digital gauge cluster.

Cargo space remains practical with 15.1 cubic feet in the trunk. Split-folding rear seats allow owners to load longer items when necessary.

How the Camry Compares to Larger Toyota Models

Family buyers frequently debate between a sedan and a larger crossover. A traditional car sits lower, handles sharper, and costs less to fuel than a heavy SUV.

For instance, shoppers tracking the toyota 4runner price or evaluating a toyota 4 runner 2025 face much steeper fuel costs during daily commutes. Meanwhile, utility shoppers eyeing a 2025 toyota highlander gain three-row seating at the expense of maneuverability.

Buyers who want off-road capability often check out the upcoming 2026 toyota 4runner instead of a sedan. But for paved highway driving, the Camry remains the superior commuter choice.

The base LE model starts at an MSRP of approximately $28,400, excluding destination fees, taxes, and optional equipment packages.

Does the 2025 Toyota Camry offer all-wheel drive?

Yes, electronic all-wheel drive is available as an option on every trim level by adding a rear electric motor to the hybrid powertrain.

Front-wheel drive models achieve up to an EPA-estimated 53 mpg in the city and 50 mpg on the highway for the base LE trim.

No, Toyota eliminated traditional gas-only engines for this generation, making every single 2025 Camry a standard hybrid vehicle.

What horsepower does the hybrid system produce?

Front-wheel-drive variants produce 225 net horsepower, while all-wheel-drive configurations generate 232 net horsepower.

What size infotainment screens are available?

Lower trims feature an 8.0-inch touchscreen display, while upper XLE and XSE trims upgrade to a larger 12.3-inch touchscreen.
